name: VINS Nature Camp
description_short: A nature camp run by the Vermont Institute of Natural Science, with most of the day spent outdoors hiking, looking at wildlife and habitats, doing crafts and playing group games, plus programs with VINS's resident raptors. It offers half-day camps for ages 4-5, day camps for grades 1-8, and overnight camps for grades 4-8.
special_needs_notes: VINS says it tries to meet individual needs as far as its facilities, terrain, staff training and camper-to-staff ratios allow. Contact the Director of Nature Camp to talk about accommodations.
